missionSelect.title: Missions
missionSelect.difficultyHint.easy: Easy: tips come sooner and go further, the burn planner proposes burns, extra spares.
missionSelect.difficultyHint.normal: Normal: tips escalate in layers, burn preview with markers, standard spares.

briefing.guidedFirstRunHint: Short callouts during the calm opening. They never pause the flight.
briefing.noPause: The flight does not pause once it begins.

loadingLines: Warming up the mainframe. It shares a socket with the coffee machine.
Sharpening the slide rules. Both of them.
Locating the flight plan. It was filed under 'Miscellaneous, Ambitious'.
Requisition form 7-B approved. Requisition form 7-A remains under review.
Rewinding the telemetry tape. Carefully. It is the only one.
Reviewing the mission statement: 'Further, higher, within budget.' Two out of three.
Counting paper clips. Procurement wants a number by Friday.
Calibrating the wall clock against the other wall clock.

externalView.firstUseLegend: Grey means not yet confirmed, not undamaged.
externalView.firstUseLegendDetail: A part turns to full colour only when someone has actually looked at it or tested it. Alarms and guesses never colour anything in.

escMenu.title: Simulation frozen
escMenu.body: The flight is stopped at this exact moment and resumes from it.
escMenu.restartConfirm: Restart the mission from the beginning? This run ends without a grade.
escMenu.abandonConfirm: Leave this mission and return to the menu? This run ends without a grade.
escMenu.encyclopediaUnavailable: The encyclopedia is not available while the simulation is frozen.
escMenu.keysHint: Esc resumes · Restart and Abandon ask first
escMenu.frozenEffect: Mission time, tasks and resources stay frozen until you choose.
escMenu.crashNoticeSaved: A report was saved to {path}. You can keep playing.
escMenu.crashNoticeNotSaved: A report could not be saved; the game log has the details. You can keep playing.
escMenu.crashNoticeMenuHint: Or return to the menu: this run then ends without a grade.

freezeOverlay.title: Connection to crew systems lost. Mission frozen.
freezeOverlay.body: Nothing is moving: no mission time, no tasks, no resources. The flight resumes from this exact moment when the connection returns.
freezeOverlay.noDoubleExecution: Orders already sent will not run twice.
freezeOverlay.notAFailure: A lost connection never counts against your grade.
freezeOverlay.hintProxyDown: The local proxy on this computer stopped answering. Start it again with backend\run_backend.ps1; the flight resumes on its own.
freezeOverlay.hintServiceDown: The local proxy is running but cannot reach {services}. Check this computer's internet connection; the flight resumes on its own.
freezeOverlay.hintUnconfigured: The local proxy has no working key for {services}. Add it to backend/.env and restart the proxy.

privacy.title: Voice and privacy
privacy.notice: When you speak or type to the crew, your voice audio and text are sent to external services, ElevenLabs (speech) and Google (language), through the local proxy running on this computer. Nothing else about you is sent. You can turn the microphone off at any time; the whole game remains playable with text alone.

encyclopedia.askHint: Explains how things work · never what to do

settings.title: Settings
settings.audioSpeechHint: Crew voices and the flight director.

settings.uiScaleHint: 80–150 %. Text never goes below 12 px effective.
settings.highContrastHint: Black panels, white text, 2 px borders, solid badges.
settings.reducedMotionHint: No camera shake, softer reveals, shorter transitions.

settings.tutorialCalloutsHint: Short anchored callouts in the calm opening. They never pause the flight.
settings.tipFrequencyHint: Easy: fast. Normal: layered. Hard (campaign): slow, no unsolicited solutions. Tips never affect the grade.

impact.undock.separates_lodestar: Gemini 8 separates from Agena. The docked burn needs the two joined again.
impact.undock.inertia_drops: Without Agena's mass, any rotation speeds up.
impact.open_breaker.oams_thruster: That OAMS thruster loses power and cannot fire until its breaker is closed again.
impact.open_breaker.rcs_ring: That RCS ring loses power and cannot hold attitude until its breaker is closed again.
impact.close_breaker.oams_thruster: That OAMS thruster gets power back. If it is faulty, it can fire without being commanded.
impact.close_breaker.rcs_ring: That RCS ring's valve drivers get power back, along with any fault in them.
impact.oams_master.attitude_control_changes: All 16 OAMS thrusters switch together. Off means no OAMS attitude control or translation; on brings every thruster back, faulty ones included.
impact.arm_rcs_ring.mission_rule_return: Mission rule: arming an RCS ring means returning at the next suitable recovery zone.
impact.arm_rcs_ring.objectives_at_risk: The docked burn and the EVA will be abandoned.
impact.disarm_rcs_ring.ring_unavailable: The ring stops holding attitude. Disarming does not lift the early-return rule.
impact.eva_retrieve_package.cabin_depressurised: The cabin is depressurised for the EVA.
impact.eva_retrieve_package.crew_exposed: June works outside the spacecraft. Any rotation puts her at risk.
impact.install_repair.uses_parts: The parts in this design leave the spares for good.
impact.jettison_equipment.loses_oams_power_cryo: The OAMS, fuel cells, cryogenic oxygen and radiator go with the equipment section. From then on the re-entry module runs on its batteries alone.
impact.retrofire.commits_to_entry: Retrofire cannot be stopped. The capsule will re-enter.
impact.retrofire.attitude_control_unavailable: If attitude is not held retrograde, the burn goes off-axis and the landing point moves.
impact.jettison_retro.exposes_heat_shield: The spent retro section is released, uncovering the heat shield for entry.
impact.deploy_drogue.single_use: The drogue deploys once. Outside its altitude and speed limits it can fail.
impact.deploy_main.single_use: The main parachute deploys once. Outside its altitude and speed limits it can fail.
impact.entry_checklist.automatic_chutes: The drogue and main parachutes will deploy on their own at the nominal altitudes.
impact.set_ration.crew_health_cost: Below normal rations, the crew lose health over time.
impact.oams_burn.changes_orbit: The burn changes the orbit, and with it every later pass over the recovery zones.
impact.oams_burn.uses_propellant: The burn uses OAMS propellant that attitude control also needs.
impact.remote_breaker.survival_load_off: The cabin heater loses power, and the cabin will start to cool.
impact.remote_bus_tie.shares_faults: Tied buses share their loads and their faults; split buses keep a fault on one side.
impact.lodestar_burn.changes_orbit: The burn changes the orbit of both vehicles.
impact.lodestar_burn.loads_docking_adapter: The burn loads the docking adapter. Any rotation adds to that load.
